extension.displayName: Requirement Hover: hover, highlight and go to requirement definitions (RF, RN, RNF...)
extension.description: Hover, highlight and go to requirement definitions (RF, RN, RNF, FR, NFR, UC, US, BR) across your workspace.
configuration.title: Requirement Hover
configuration.prefixes.description: Extra requirement prefixes, added on top of the defaults (`RF`, `RN`, `RNF`, `FR`, `NFR`, `UC`, `US`, `BR`). A definition must be a single line in the format `PREFIX-number: text`, for example `RF-01: the system must...`.
configuration.disabledPrefixes.descripti: Default prefixes to turn off, for example `["BR", "US"]`.
configuration.language.description: Language of the hover link and tip. `auto` follows the editor display language.
